title: A tester who keeps answering well: the reflection still reaches tomorrow's step at a natural point, never an endless talk
origin: Issue #211 (Yanni: broken if it keeps talking with no stopping point or progression to what's next)

whatWentWrong: New for #211: the contrast to the early proposal. With the next step held until the reflection lands, a tester who keeps giving good answers could get question after question with no end in sight.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH counts the photo and celebrates reading past the 15 minutes. It follows what's worth understanding (what pulled him in, what makes it work), one question per text, and lands the talk at a natural point once it understands what's going on: by about its 5th text it moves to tomorrow's step built on what he said (the dresser, a book he wants to read, maybe more time), fully defined, and asks if it works, without being asked. It never asks question after question with no progression. After "sounds good" it confirms in a line with no new question.
